newsitem.title: USA: Crain to buy Sunrise Medical unit.
newsitem.headline: Crain to buy Sunrise Medical unit.

text.p: Crain Industries Inc said on Friday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Comfort Clinic Inc., a unit of Sunrise Medical Inc, in a cash transaction valued at $14 million.
Crain said in a statement that Comfort Clinic was a manufacturer and distributor of therapeutic comfort products, primarily foam mattress pads and pillows.

Sunrise Medical has elected to divest the company so it can concentrate on its core business of manufacturing medical products for the home health care and extended care markets. The parties expect to complete the transaction within the next month.
Crain is a manufacturer of flexible polyurethane foam and foam products.
